title: Pressure Vessels
summary: Custom pressure vessels, drums and storage equipment built to project-specific pressure, temperature, material and code requirements.
body:
Tongyang manufactures engineered pressure vessels for chemical, petrochemical, energy and industrial utility services. Each vessel is reviewed against the specified operating envelope, fabrication drawings and project documentation requirements.

Typical applications

  • Process drums, accumulators, receivers and buffer vessels
  • Gas and liquid storage or surge duties
  • Adsorber shells and other pressure-containing process equipment
  • Custom vessels with nozzles, supports, manways and specified internals

Key technical parameters for quotation

  • Capacity & configuration: total/working volume, vertical or horizontal, overall dimensions
  • Design basis: operating/design pressure and temperature, vacuum requirement, medium and fluid group
  • Construction: material, corrosion allowance, lining/cladding, insulation and coating
  • Interfaces: nozzle schedule, internals, supports, lifting and transport restrictions
  • Quality: required NDE, hydrostatic/pneumatic testing, third-party inspection and documentation

Manufacturing & applicable standards

Fabrication, welding procedures, material traceability and inspection plans are defined by the agreed specification. Mechanical design may reference ASME Section VIII, GB/T 150 or EN 13445 where applicable. PED or EAC/TR CU conformity requirements are evaluated separately according to destination, service and contractual scope.

Quotation basis: submit a data sheet or GA drawing for a project-specific design and manufacturing review. Code edition, certification marking and inspections must be confirmed in the final offer; no fixed pressure rating is implied by this product page.
seoDescription: Explore custom pressure vessel fabrication with engineering support, material selection, inspection and project-specific design requirements.
